input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. The subscription grant (13.1) expressly extends to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf, with no notice precondition; paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology (13.2) is licensed perpetually, irrevocably and royalty-free to Customer and its Affiliates with contractor support permitted; and 13.3 allows transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right and limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity. Termination rights in Section 9 do not create any at-will revocation in Vendor's favour (9.1 requires uncured material breach; 9.4 is a Customer-side right). No redline required.
